topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I couldn't believe my eyes when I stumbled upon my college application essay, right there on the university’s admissions blog. It was like finding out a piece of your hard work had been recognized in a way you never expected. The words seemed to leap off the page, even though I had written them myself. They were under a section titled "Exceptional Essays," and that made the discovery all the more special. It was a reminder of the effort I put into every word, and seeing it out there, helping others, was just... rewarding. I even caught myself smiling as I read through it again, imagining how it might inspire someone else to tell their story with the same honesty and passion.
